t: Context estimation is unreliable — use /context measurement only, never guess percentages
description: Session 102 estimated context at 48% when actual was 18% (2.4x overestimate). Root causes: (1) WAI-State.json had context_limit=200000 but Opus 4.6 has 1M context. (2) Token counting from file sizes and turn counts is fundamentally inaccurate. Fix: protocol now says NEVER estimate — use /context output only. If not run, state 'unknown'. This supersedes signal-context-estimation-accuracy-v1.
